style: Photoreal cinematic macro photograph, vertical 9:16 composition, optical laboratory subject on a dark neutral surface, soft directional key light with a clean falloff, shallow depth of field, muted cool colours, shot on 35mm, quiet uncluttered realism.
ref_hint: Match the reference image exactly for lighting direction, colour grade, background surface and overall look. Same studio, same session.

images.prompt: A single modern spectacle lens standing upright on a dark matte surface, lit from one side so the curved face catches a long soft highlight, the lens edge clearly visible as a thin bright line, plenty of empty dark space above.
A pair of thin-rimmed reading glasses lying open on a printed page on the same dark surface, the printed lines beneath the lenses rendered soft and unreadable while the page beyond stays crisp.
Macro view of an older bifocal lens on the same surface, the small D-shaped reading segment near the bottom edge showing a hard visible boundary line across the glass.
The same bifocal lens tilted so the segment boundary catches the key light as a sharp bright seam running across the lens, the two zones on either side of it reflecting at visibly different angles.

A progressive lens photographed edge-on against the dark background, its cross-section thickening smoothly and continuously from the top edge toward the bottom, the profile line reading as one unbroken curve.

Looking straight through a progressive lens resting above a printed grid of fine squares, the grid sharp through a narrow vertical band down the middle and progressively smeared and bent toward both left and right edges.
A short row of circular lens blanks of increasing curvature standing on edge on the dark surface, each one bulging a little more than the one before, raking light along the row.
An optical surfacing machine at work, a diamond tool cutting a fine spiral track across a spinning lens blank, coolant misting, industrial and precise.
A finished progressive lens seated in a thin metal frame, front view on the dark surface, the whole surface clean and even with a single soft reflection curving across it.
A concrete staircase seen looking down from the top step, the treads receding sharply below, cool overcast light, the lower steps falling into shadow.

Three progressive lenses in a row on the dark surface, each with a visibly narrower clear vertical band down its centre than the one before, the surrounding areas showing stronger reflected distortion.
Closing shot: the thin-rimmed glasses folded on the dark surface, one soft light from the side, long quiet shadow, generous empty space around them.

clips.prompt: Live-action documentary footage, one continuous locked-off shot. The scene holds exactly as in the first frame. The key light drifts a few degrees so the highlight travels slowly along the curved lens face.

Live-action documentary footage, one continuous locked-off shot. The scene holds exactly as in the first frame. A slow dolly along the lens edge from its thin top toward its thicker bottom.

Live-action documentary footage, one continuous locked-off shot. The scene holds exactly as in the first frame. A very slow drift across the grid, the clear middle band staying put while the smeared edges pass through frame.
Live-action documentary footage, one continuous locked-off shot. The scene holds exactly as in the first frame. The framed lens turns a few degrees so the soft reflection sweeps across its surface.
Live-action documentary footage, one continuous locked-off shot. The scene holds exactly as in the first frame. A very slow drift back from the folded glasses, the shadow lengthening slightly.
